plugins.name: tw-dev
plugins.description: Dev-phase SDLC skills for any kind of development: orchestrate, requirements, design, coding (web, API, CLI, library, mobile, data/ML — single or multi-component with interface contracts; its test agents write ALL automated tests — full unit and integration coverage), and compliance — stack and project-type agnostic. Manual test planning lives in the tw-qa plugin.

plugins.name: tw-qa
plugins.description: Manual QA planning — /qa drafts the manual testing plan for a change set (typically what the tw-dev coding agent just built) into docs/test/TEST_PLAN-*.md (+ importable CSV): full step-by-step instructions, concrete test data creation steps with cleanup, boundary/negative/authorization cases, regression checklist, sign-off. Documents only — all automated tests (unit + integration) are written by tw-dev /coding. Standalone or as Phase 4 of the tw-dev orchestrator.

plugins.name: tw-ba
plugins.description: Domain-agnostic business analysis — /ba drives discovery → domain & process analysis → UX & data modeling → compliance requirements → functional spec (FRD + RTM) into docs/ba/, knowledge-graph context first. Industry specifics via optional domain references; hands off to tw-dev.

plugins.name: tw-hooks
plugins.description: Shared guardrail hooks for all TechWave plugins — install alongside tw-ba/tw-dev/tw-qa. PreToolUse sensitive-data guard blocks reading or exfiltrating secret files (.env, private keys, cloud credentials, tfstate); PostToolUse compliance scan warns on hardcoded credentials, PII in logs, and cloud access keys in written files. Moved out of tw-dev so every plugin shares one guardrail set.

plugins.name: tw-atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian MCP integration — connects Jira and Confluence to the tw-dev orchestrator via OAuth browser login. Install separately; no authentication is forced on tw-dev users.
